biotools.summary: iARPlus is a web-based platform designed to facilitate remote-customized telecontrol for patients with rheumatoid arthritis, enabling monitoring of disease activity through the RAID approach. A pilot study showed correlations between CDAI and RAID scores and demonstrated better outcomes with JAKi treatment.
